actual: The target executed end-to-end (drive staged, turn resolved cancelled) and failed on its planned fan-in assertion: the back-leg transcript carries ZERO reply envelopes for fake-2 within the bound and the fake's honest unanswered-at note IS present — the mine arm at HEAD fires machine.Cancel only and never fans the pendings in, so the bridge dangled to the fake's 500ms reverse deadline. This is precisely the planned missing-fan-in RED signal (WR-06). Re-verified with the COMMITTED (amended) test against the pre-fix production files checked out from the RED commit's parent: identical failure line (cancel_test.go:486, 0 replies + note present).
semanticAssessment: Genuine RED, and a legitimate enshrining-test INVERSION rather than a weakening: the previous revision of this test asserted the dangling artifact as expected (assertDanglingAskNote — the delta review WR-06 and the verifier's gap 3 both classified that dangle as a contract violation of the 05-02 prohibition). The rewrite inverts the dangle assertions into fan-in assertions (exactly one -32021 reply envelope, no unanswered-at note), keeps every surviving lock (exactly-once cancelled success response, single session/send, no -32800), deletes the assert-the-defect helper, and re-homes the old tail's slot-free skip lock into Task 2's dedicated test. The target compiled, executed, and failed on the planned assertion (0 replies + note present) — not a build failure, not zero-test discovery, not an unrelated assertion.
